company_description.value: TIPS Music Limited (formerly Tips Industries Limited) is engaged in the acquisition and exploitation of music rights, with a large and diversified music library of 34,000+ songs across major genres and 25+ languages, licensed to leading global digital platforms (YouTube, Spotify, JioSaavn, Apple Music, Amazon Prime Music, and others). The company also has a legacy in Hindi and Punjabi film production (its Film Division was demerged in FY22). It is listed on the BSE and NSE, incorporated in 1996 (predecessor entity from 1975), headquartered in Mumbai, and operates as a single reportable business segment (Music).
company_description.source: Notes to Financial Statements (Note 1, entity background), p.~130; Directors' Report/MD&A on nature of industry; Segment Reporting Note 38(8). Paraphrased, not quoted, from the AR.

group_description.value: No separate corporate group description applicable - see hq_group note. Related entity of note: Tips Films Limited (India), an enterprise significantly influenced by the promoter/KMP family, engaged in film production and supplying audio-video content rights to TIPS Music (Rs 968.00 lakhs FY25 / Rs 1,433.20 lakhs FY24) - a domestic related party, not a foreign AE.

ae_revenue_split.source: BRSR Section: 'The contribution of exports is 68.66% of total turnover of the company' (FY25 only - no comparable disclosed for FY24), p.~76. Applied 68.66% to Revenue from Operations (Rs 31,068.73 lakhs, NOT Total Income) to get export third-party revenue = Rs 21,335.8 lakhs; remainder Rs 9,732.9 lakhs is domestic third-party.
ae_revenue_split.flag: IMPORTANT judgment call: TIPS has no foreign/international related parties in its Note 38(7) disclosure (only Indian entities: Tips Films Limited, Mobify Technology Solutions) - so unlike Thomas Cook, ALL related-party transactions here appear to be domestic, and effectively 0 is entered for every AE row. The large export figure (68.66% of turnover) is licensing revenue to foreign THIRD-PARTY platforms (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube are not AEs of TIPS), not AE revenue. FY24 split not found - BRSR export-contribution disclosure appears to be current-year-only in this AR; left blank rather than guessed. This company's TP profile (no foreign AEs, but majority-export third-party revenue) is materially different from Thomas Cook's (foreign AE + domestic AE + third-party mix) - worth flagging to the reviewer explicitly since it changes what TP analysis is even relevant here.

related_party_transactions_lakhs.flag: TIPS's actual related-party transactions don't map cleanly onto this row template (built for a company like Thomas Cook with clear AE service flows). TIPS's disclosed RPT are: rent paid, director remuneration/salaries, sitting fees, reimbursement of expenses (Rs -17.80 lakhs, i.e. net receivable - mapped to 'Reimbursement expenses'), advances against remuneration, and 'Audio Video Rights Expenses' from Tips Films Limited (Rs 968.00 lakhs FY25 / Rs 1,433.20 lakhs FY24) which is the closest match to 'Cost of services' (content licensing cost). No related-party 'Sale of Services', interest income, group management fees, or reimbursements received were found - left blank (not 0) because these categories may simply not apply to this company's related-party profile, which is a different situation from 'looked and found zero'.
